## "institution"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
NHMD, AU

**Description of metadata field:**  
The name of the Institution which owns and digitised the specime. This tells us ownership, allows us to map to Specify and facilitates management and reporting.Required field for creating an asset in ARS.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Input comes from the digitiser when using the ingestion client, and the field gets populated when the asset has its initial metadata created by the ingestion server.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never.

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
institution

**Maps to in Specify:**  
Maps to Specify Installation. Defines the values in Copyright Holder, License and Credit

**Notes and issues:**  
An asset cannot change institution.
